description: Add message injection API, interactive mo attach stdin, and Web UI message input for free-text user messages to paused agent sessions

tasks.title: Add POST /api/issues/:number/messages endpoint
tasks.description: Add message injection endpoint to api/issues.ts. It should: (1) Check hasPausedSession(issueNumber), (2) Call agentRunner.resume() with user message, (3) Return 200 on success, 409 if agent not paused, 404 if issue not found. Need agentRunnerService injected into the route factory.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 409 when agent is not paused
Message is injected into agent session and agent resumes
tasks.notes: The route factory already receives agentRunnerService (check current signature). If not, add it.

tasks.title: Extend mo attach with interactive stdin
tasks.description: Extend cli/commands/attach.ts to support interactive mode. When agent_paused event is received, show a prompt (e.g., '> ') and read stdin lines. Each line is sent as POST /api/issues/:number/messages. When agent resumes, disable stdin prompt. Use Node.js readline module.
acceptanceCriteria: mo attach shows input prompt when agent_paused event received
User can type message and press Enter to send
Prompt disabled when agent resumes (agent_started event)
SSE output and stdin prompt don't garble each other
tasks.notes: Use readline.createInterface for stdin. On agent_paused, call rl.prompt(). On agent_started, call rl.close() or hide prompt. Need to track which issue is paused.

tasks.title: Add message input to Web UI
tasks.description: Add a message input area to IssueDetailPage.tsx that appears when agent is paused. Include a text input and 'Send' button. On submit, call POST /api/issues/:number/messages. Clear input on success. Show inline error if agent is not paused (race condition).
acceptanceCriteria: Message input area visible when agent status is 'paused'
User can type and send message
Message sent via API on submit
Error displayed if send fails (409 etc.)
tasks.notes: Add a sendMessage mutation hook in useQueries.ts. The input area should be near the approval panel.

tasks.title: Verify build and manual test
tasks.description: Build, typecheck, and manual test: start server, start issue, wait for gate pause, send message via API/curl, verify agent resumes. Test mo attach interactive mode. Test Web UI message input.
tasks.notes: Test three channels: API (curl), mo attach (stdin), Web UI (browser).
